params.active: Engages the lob: when on, plays from the read head jumped back by Slices Back. Pads override this momentarily.
params.offset: How many tempo-locked slices behind 'now' the read head jumps when lobbing.
params.division: Slice length on the tempo grid: 0=1/4, 1=1/8, 2=1/16, 3=1/4T, 4=1/8T, 5=1/16T.
params.mode: Play mode: 0=Live (lob the live input buffer), 1=Loop (play the captured loop, tempo-followed), 2=Slice (fire one slice of the captured loop over the live input).
params.loop: When on, repeats the jumped slice (stutter). When off, plays through the buffer from the jump point (delay throw). Used in Live and Loop modes.
params.ratchet: Subdivides the loop window for faster repeats (0=full slice, each step halves it).
params.freeze: Stops recording so the live buffer holds (record-stop).
params.mute: Silences the dry/live path; the wet toss/slice still plays.
params.capture: Rising edge snapshots the most recent Loop Beats of audio into the loop buffer (and retriggers it). Loop/Slice modes auto-capture once on first entry.
params.loop_beats: Musical length in beats of the captured loop (1..16), used by Loop and Slice modes.
params.mix: Wet/dry balance of the lobbed signal against the live input.
params.bpm: Fallback tempo used when the host clock is unavailable (e.g. the browser). On device the host tempo wins.
params.xfade: Declick crossfade length in milliseconds applied at every read-head jump and loop seam.
